qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act gave 'Constitutional Status' to Panchayati Raj?
e: 1. Core Concept: 73rd Amendment (1992). \n2. Logic: Isne Samvidhan mein 'Part IX' aur '11th Schedule' joda. \n3. Fact: 24 April ko har saal 'Panchayati Raj Diwas' manaya jata hai.

qe: Bihar was the FIRST state to provide what percentage of reservation to Women in Panchayats?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Bihar ne 'Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006' ke tehat mahilaon ko 50% arakshan diya. \n2. Fact: Central law sirf 33% kehta hai, par Bihar ne use badha kar 50% kiya.

qe: The 'Three-tier' system of Panchayati Raj was recommended by which committee?
o: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (बलवंत राय मेहता समिति)
e: 1. History: 1957 mein Balwant Rai Mehta ne Gram, Block aur Zila level par 3-tier system ki rai di thi. \n2. Fact: Inhe 'Father of Panchayati Raj' in India bhi kaha jata hai.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to 'Organize Village Panchayats'?
e: 1. Core Concept: DPSP. \n2. Logic: Article 40 Gandhi ji ke sapno ko pura karne ke liye rakha gaya tha. \n3. Note: Tab ye sirf ek nirdesh tha, mandatory nahi.

qe: What is the minimum 'Age' to contest elections for a Mukhiya or Ward Member in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility. \n2. Logic: Vote dene ke liye 18 saal, par election ladne ke liye 21 saal hona zaroori hai. \n3. Comparison: MLA ke liye 25 saal chahiye.

qe: The 'Gram Katchery' (ग्राम कचहरी) in Bihar is headed by?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Mukhiya administrative kaam dekhta hai, par Sarpanch 'Gram Katchery' ka head hota hai jo chhote-mote jhagde suljhata hai. \n2. Power: Sarpanch ₹10,000 tak ke maamlo ki sunvai kar sakta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Executive Officer' at the Panchayat Samiti (Block) level?
e: 1. Structure: Block level par BDO hi executive head hota hai jo Panchayat Samiti ke kamo ko lagoo karta hai. \n2. Elected Head: Panchayat Samiti ka elected head 'Pramukh' hota hai.

qe: Which Schedule was added to the Constitution for 'Urban Local Bodies' (Municipalities)?
e: 1. Core Concept: 74th Amendment. \n2. Logic: 11th Schedule Panchayato ke liye hai aur 12th Municipalities ke liye. \n3. List: 12th Schedule mein 18 subjects (kaam) diye gaye hain.

qe: The 'State Election Commission' conducts elections for?
e: 1. Logic: ECI (India) bade elections karwata hai, par SEC sirf local bodies ke liye banta hai. \n2. Article: Article 243K iska zikr karta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Administrative Head' of a Gram Panchayat in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Mukhiya chuna hua hota hai (Elected), par Panchayat Secretary sarkari naukar hota hai jo records rakhta hai. \n2. Note: Ise 'Panchayat Sewak' bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is the tenure of Panchayati Raj institutions in Bihar?
e: 1. Rule: Pehli meeting se exact 5 saal tak. \n2. Dissolution: Agar pehle bhang ho jaye, toh 6 mahine ke andar election hona mandatory hai.

qe: The 'Zila Parishad' Chairman in Bihar is called?
e: 1. Hierarchy: Gram Panchayat (Mukhiya) -> Panchayat Samiti (Pramukh) -> Zila Parishad (Adhyaksha).

qe: Which Article provides for the 'State Finance Commission' for Panchayats?
e: 1. Logic: 280 Central Finance Commission ke liye hai, 243-I State ke liye. \n2. Work: Ye tay karta hai ki state govt ka kitna paisa Panchayato ko milega.

qe: The 'Gram Sabha' consists of:
o: All registered voters of the village (गाँव के सभी पंजीकृत मतदाता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Direct Democracy. \n2. Fact: Har wo insaan jiska naam voter list mein hai, wo Gram Sabha ka member hota hai. \n3. Power: Ye Panchayat ke kamo ka audit karti hai.

qe: How many functional items are listed in the '11th Schedule' of the Constitution?
e: 1. Logic: Panchayato ko 29 subjects par kaam karne ki power di gayi hai (jaise Agriculture, Health, Road). \n2. Municipalities: Unke liye 12th Schedule mein 18 items hain.

qe: Who appoints the 'State Election Commissioner' of Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Local bodies ke saare head Governor hi appoint karta hai. \n2. Note: Use hatane ka process High Court ke judge jaisa tough hota hai.

qe: In Bihar, what is the 'Population Criteria' for forming a Gram Panchayat?
e: 1. Bihar Rule: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act ke hisab se lagbhag 7,000 ki abadi par ek Gram Panchayat banti hai. \n2. Ward: Lagbhag 500 ki abadi par ek 'Ward' banta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief' of the Gram Katchery in Bihar?
e: 1. Role: Sarpanch kanooni mamlo ko dekhta hai. \n2. Support: Sarpanch ki help ke liye ek 'Nyay Mitra' (Law expert) hota hai.

qe: Which part of the Constitution deals with 'The Municipalities'?
e: 1. Structure: Part IX (Panchayat), Part IX-A (Municipalities). \n2. Addition: Ise 74th Amendment (1992) se joda gaya.

qe: The 'District Planning Committee' (DPC) is mentioned in which Article?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: DPC ka kaam Zila Parishad aur Municipalities ke plans ko milakar ek 'Draft Development Plan' banana hota hai.

qe: Who elects the 'Up-Mukhiya' (Deputy Mukhiya) in a Gram Panchayat in Bihar?
o: Elected Ward Members among themselves (निर्वाचित वार्ड सदस्यों द्वारा अपने बीच से)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Mukhiya ka election 'Direct' hota hai (janata gunti hai). \n2. Process: Par Up-Mukhiya ka election 'Indirect' hota hai, jahan Ward Members apne beech se ek ko chunte hain. \n3. Tie: Agar vote barabar ho jayein, toh faisla 'Lottery' se hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Reservation of Seats' for SC, ST and Women in Panchayats?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Justice. \n2. Logic: 243-D (D for Dalits//Disadvantaged) reservation se deal karta hai. \n3. Fact: Bihar mein isi Article ke tehat BC (Backwards) ko bhi reservation diya gaya hai.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Term' for which a Panchayat can be dissolved?
e: 1. Rule: Article 243-E. Agar Panchayat bhang hoti hai, toh 6 mahine ke andar election karwana mandatory hai. \n2. Note: Agar term khatam hone mein sirf 6 mahine bache hon, toh naya election zaroori nahi hota.

qe: Who is the 'Political Head' of a Municipal Corporation (Nagar Nigam) in Bihar?
e: 1. Structure: Nagar Nigam ka elected head Mayor hota hai. \n2. Update: Bihar mein ab Mayor aur Deputy Mayor ka election janata 'Direct' (seedhe) karti hai. \n3. Fact: Commissioner sarkari (IAS) officer hota hai.

qe: Under Article 243-S, 'Wards Committees' are mandatory for municipalities having population of?
o: 3 Lakh or more (3 लाख या अधिक)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Badi cities mein behtar management ke liye Ward Committees banai jati hain. \n2. Logic: Ye janata ki samasyaon ko Ward level par hi suljhane ke liye hoti hain.

qe: Who provides the 'Nyay Mitra' (Law Assistant) to help the Sarpanch in Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Nyay Mitra ek kanooni expert (vakeel) hota hai jise sarkar appoint karti hai taaki Sarpanch kanoon ke hisab se faisle le sake. \n2. Fact: Iska kaam sirf 'Salah' dena hota hai.

qe: The '12th Schedule' of the Constitution lists how many functional items for Municipalities?
e: 1. Comparison: 11th Schedule (Panchayat) - 29 items. 12th Schedule (Municipalities) - 18 items. \n2. Subjects: Isme Fire services, Urban forestry, Slum improvement jaise kaam shamil hain.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Constitution of Finance Commission' to review financial position of Panchayats?
o: Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 243-I Panchayato ke liye hai aur 243-Y Municipalities ke liye. \n2. Period: Governor ise har 5 saal mein banata hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Remove' the Mukhiya in Bihar if he is found guilty of misconduct?
e: 1. Power: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act ke tehat, sarkar (Department of Panchayati Raj) jaanch ke baad Mukhiya ko pad se hata sakti hai. \n2. Appeal: Mukhiya iske khilaaf court ja sakta hai.

qe: The 'Panchayat Samiti' in Bihar is the ________ level of the Panchayati Raj system.
e: 1. Structure: Gram Panchayat (Ground) -> Panchayat Samiti (Middle) -> Zila Parishad (Top). \n2. Logic: Ye gaon aur zile ke beech ka bridge hai.

qe: Under Article 243-Q, a 'Nagar Panchayat' is formed for?
o: Transition areas from rural to urban (ग्रामीण से शहरी संक्रमणकालीन क्षेत्र)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 3 types of Municipalities: 1. Nagar Panchayat (Transition gaon se shehar). 2. Nagar Parishad (Chote shehar). 3. Nagar Nigam (Bade shehar).

qe: What is the 'Audit' authority of the Gram Sabha in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Audit. \n2. Logic: Gram Sabha ye check karti hai ki jo paisa gaon ke liye aaya, wo sach mein kharch hua ya nahi. \n3. Importance: Isse bhrashtachar par rok lagti hai.

qe: Who provides the 'Voter List' for Panchayat elections in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: SEC ki apni voter list hoti hai jo ECI ki list se alag ho sakti hai. \n2. Responsibility: Article 243-K ke tehat ye SEC ka kaam hai.

qe: Can a person be a member of both 'Zila Parishad' and 'Legislative Assembly' (MLA) at once?
e: 1. Rule: Dual membership par rok hai. Agar koi MLA ban jata hai, toh use apni local body ki seat chhodni padegi. \n2. Logic: Ek insaan do jagah ka budget aur power control nahi kar sakta.

qe: The '73rd Amendment' does NOT apply to which of the following states?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 243-M ke tehat in states ko chhoot mili hai kyunki wahan unki apni tribal systems hain. \n2. Special Fact: West Bengal ka 'Darjeeling District' bhi isse bahar hai.

qe: Who is the 'Executive Officer' of a Municipal Corporation in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Mayor 'Head' hai, par asli administrative kaam Municipal Commissioner (IAS rank) karta hai. \n2. Analogy: Jaise CM aur Chief Secretary.

qe: Under Article 243-W, who has the power to 'Empower' Municipalities with duties?
e: 1. Federal Logic: Local bodies 'State List' ka subject hain, isliye Assembly hi tay karti hai ki unhe kitni power deni hai.

qe: What happens if a Panchayat is dissolved with only 4 months of its term remaining?
o: No immediate election required (तत्काल चुनाव की आवश्यकता नहीं)
e: 1. Rule: Agar 6 mahine se kam time bacha hai, toh alag se by-election karwane ki zaroorat nahi hai. \n2. Note: Seedha naya general election hi hoga.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'District Planning Committee' (DPC)?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: DPC shehari aur gramin dono plans ko milakar poore zile ka plan banati hai. \n2. Structure: Isme 4//5 members elected hote hain.

qe: The 'Gram Katchery' can hear both Civil and Criminal cases. True or False?
e: 1. Power: Bihar mein Sarpanch dono tarah ke chhote cases sun sakta hai. \n2. Limit: Par wo kisi ko jail nahi bhej sakta, sirf fine (jurmana) laga sakta hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Boundaries' of a Ward in a Bihar Municipal Corporation?
e: 1. Fact: Ward ka delimitation (parisiman) Bihar sarkar ka Urban Development department karta hai.

qe: Under Article 243-G, what is the 'Panchayat's Responsibility'?
o: Economic development and social justice (आर्थिक विकास और सामाजिक न्याय)
e: 1. Mission: Panchayato ko sirf galiyan banane ke liye nahi, balki gaon ke vikas ke liye banaya gaya hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief' of the Panchayat Samiti in Bihar?
e: 1. Status: Pramukh ko Block level ke saare Mukhiya aur Samiti members chunte hain.

qe: Can the 'State Election Commissioner' be removed by the Governor easily?
o: No, only on grounds and manner of a High Court Judge (नहीं, केवल HC जज के समान तरीके से)
e: 1. Security: SEC ko independence di gayi hai taaki wo bina dare election karwa sake. \n2. Method: Removal ke liye President aur Parliament ka involvement zaroori hota hai.

qe: The 'Nagar Nigam' (Municipal Corporation) is established for population above?
o: As decided by the State (राज्य द्वारा निर्धारित)
e: 1. Logic: Samvidhan ginti nahi batata, ye State Govt ke upar chhod diya gaya hai. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar mein Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur jaise bade sheharo mein Nagar Nigam hai.

qe: Who is the 'Secretary' of the Zila Parishad in Bihar?
o: DDC (Deputy Development Commissioner - उप विकास आयुक्त)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Zila Parishad ka executive kaam DDC dekhta hai jo IAS rank ka hota hai.

qe: Under Article 243-B, 'Panchayats' are mandatory for states having population above?
e: 1. Rule: Jis state ki abadi 20 lakh se kam hai, wahan 3-tier system hona zaroori nahi hai (Middle level skip ho sakta hai).

qe: Which body is responsible for 'Audit' of Municipal accounts?
o: State Government as per Law (कानून के अनुसार राज्य सरकार)
e: 1. Fact: State Legislature tay karta hai ki audit kaise aur kaun karega.

qe: Who is the 'First Citizen' of a City in Bihar?
e: 1. Protocol: Shehar ka pehla sammanit nagrik Mayor hota hai.

qe: The 'Gram Sabha' must meet at least how many times in a year in Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar Rule: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act ke tehat saal mein kam se kam 4 meetings (har 3 mahine mein ek) honi zaroori hain.

qe: Under the Bihar Panchayat Raj Act 2006, what is the percentage of seats reserved for EBCs (BC-I)?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Bihar ne pichde vargo (EBC) ko 20% arakshan diya hai. \n2. Limit: Ye arakshan Mukhiya, Pramukh aur Adhyaksha sabhi pado par lagu hota hai. \n3. Fact: Isse samaj ke dabbe hue vargo ko netritva (leadership) milta hai.

qe: Who elects the 'Up-Sarpanch' in the Gram Katchery of Bihar?
o: Elected Panches among themselves (निर्वाचित पंचों द्वारा अपने बीच से)
e: 1. Process: Sarpanch ka chunav direct hota hai, par Up-Sarpanch ko elected Panches milkar chunte hain. \n2. Role: Sarpanch ki অনুপস্থিতi (absence) mein ye Katchery ki adhyakshta karta hai.

qe: The 'Panchayat Samiti' (Block Level) is accountable for its functions to?
e: 1. Hierarchy: 3-tier system mein niche wali body upar wali ko report karti hai. \n2. Path: Gram Panchayat -> Panchayat Samiti -> Zila Parishad.

qe: Article 243-F deals with the 'Disqualifications' for membership. Who is the final authority?
o: Authority prescribed by State Law (राज्य कानून द्वारा निर्धारित अधिकारी)
e: 1. Core Concept: Authority. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar mein election ke baad disqualification par DM ya prescribed authority faisla leti hai. \n3. Age: 21 saal se kam age hona sabse bada ground hai.

qe: What is the 'Population' limit for a 'Nagar Parishad' (Municipal Council) in Bihar?
e: 1. Structure: Nagar Panchayat (12k-40k), Nagar Parishad (40k-2 Lakh), Nagar Nigam (Above 2 Lakh). \n2. Logic: Ye shehar ki abadi par depend karta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief Executive Officer' of the Zila Parishad in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Elected head Adhyaksha hota hai, par administrative head DDC (Deputy Development Commissioner) hota hai jo IAS rank ka hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Powers, Authority and Responsibilities' of Municipalities?
e: 1. Logic: 243-G Panchayato ke liye hai aur 243-W Municipalities ke liye. \n2. Scope: Isme 12th Schedule ke 18 subjects shamil hain.

qe: The 'Nyay Mitra' in Bihar must be a graduate in?
e: 1. Requirement: Chunki Nyay Mitra ko Sarpanch ko kanooni salah deni hoti hai, isliye uska 'Law Graduate' hona zaroori hai. \n2. Fact: Ye ek contractual sarkari pad hai.

qe: Under Article 243-E, if a Panchayat is dissolved, election MUST be held within?
e: 1. Rule: Samvidhan kehta hai ki seat 6 mahine se zyada khali nahi reh sakti. \n2. Note: Nayi Panchayat bache hue samay (remainder term) ke liye hi kaam karegi.

qe: Who has the power to 'Divide' a Gram Panchayat into Wards in Bihar?
e: 1. Power: DM (Collector) hi wards ki boundary aur ginti tay karta hai. \n2. Logic: Lagbhag 500 ki abadi par ek ward banaya jata hai.

qe: The '74th Constitutional Amendment' came into force on?
e: 1. Date: 73rd Amendment 24 April ko aur 74th Amendment 1 June ko lagu hua tha. \n2. Goal: Urban local governance ko mazboot karna.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian' of the Gram Panchayat's properties and funds?
e: 1. Role: Mukhiya hi executive head hai aur sari execution ki zimmedari uski hoti hai. \n2. Fact: Paisa nikalne ke liye Mukhiya aur Panchayat Secretary dono ke sign chahiye hote hain.

qe: Under Article 243-T, 'Women Reservation' in Municipalities is?
o: Not less than 1//3 (1//3 से कम नहीं)
e: 1. Central Law: 74th Amendment kam se kam 33% kehta hai. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar ne ise badha kar 50% kar diya hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Executive Officer' (E.O.) of a Nagar Parishad in Bihar?
o: Executive Officer appointed by Govt (सरकार द्वारा नियुक्त कार्यपालक पदाधिकारी)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Nagar Nigam mein 'Commissioner' hota hai, Nagar Parishad//Panchayat mein 'Executive Officer' hota hai.

qe: The 'PESA Act' (1996) extends Panchayati Raj to?
e: 1. Full Form: Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act. \n2. Logic: Ye tribal logo ki paramparao ko bachate hue unhe self-rule deta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief' of the Zila Parishad elected by members in Bihar?
e: 1. Structure: Zila Parishad ke elected members apne beech se ek Adhyaksha aur ek Up-Adhyaksha chunte hain.

qe: Article 243-C deals with the 'Composition' of Panchayats. Who decides the number of seats?
o: The State Legislature by Law (राज्य विधानमंडल कानून द्वारा)
e: 1. Power: Har state ki Assembly khud tay karti hai ki unke yahan kitne ward ya kitni seats hongi.

qe: The 'Gram Katchery' in Bihar has a 'Secretary' (Sarkari). Who is he?
e: 1. Distinction: Gram Panchayat ke liye 'Panchayat Secretary' hota hai, aur Gram Katchery ke liye 'Nyay Secretary' (Justice Secretary) hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Audit of Accounts' of Municipalities?
e: 1. Logic: 243-J (Panchayat audit), 243-Z (Municipality audit). \n2. Importance: Isse bhrashtachar par lagaam lagti hai.

qe: In Bihar, 'Ward Parshad' (Ward Councillor) is elected for?
e: 1. Terminology: Gaon mein 'Ward Member' hota hai, shehar mein 'Ward Parshad' (Councillor) hota hai.

qe: Under Article 243-R, members of Municipalities are elected by?
o: Direct Election by the people (जनता द्वारा प्रत्यक्ष चुनाव)
e: 1. Rule: Municipal areas ko wards mein baanta jata hai aur har ward ki janata apna Councillor pratyaksh (direct) chunti hai.

qe: Who is the 'Presiding Officer' of the meeting of Panchayat Samiti in Bihar?
e: 1. Hierarchy: Block level par elected head 'Pramukh' hi meeting chair karta hai. \n2. Absence: Pramukh nahi ho toh Up-Pramukh meeting leta hai.

qe: The 'District Planning Committee' (DPC) must have what fraction of elected members?
e: 1. Rule: Article 243-ZD. DPC ke 4//5 members Zila Parishad aur Municipalities ke elected sadasyo dwara chune jate hain. \n2. Logic: Isse local planning mein elected leaders ka dawab rehta hai.

qe: What is the 'Minimum Age' to vote in Panchayat elections in Bihar?
e: 1. Rule: Vote dene ka haq 18 saal par mil jata hai (Universal Adult Suffrage). \n2. Election Ladna: Chunav ladne ke liye 21 saal hona zaroori hai.

qe: Who was the Chairman of the committee that suggested 'Nyaya Panchayats'?
e: 1. History: 1977 mein Ashok Mehta committee ne judicial powers wali Nyaya Panchayato ki baat ki thi. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar ne ise 'Gram Katchery' ke roop mein apnaya hai.

qe: Under Article 243-H, who can authorize a Panchayat to levy and collect 'Taxes'?
e: 1. Power: State Assembly kanoon banakar Panchayato ko mela tax, bazar tax ya safai tax lene ki power deti hai.

qe: In Bihar, 'Nagar Nigam' (Municipal Corporation) is formed for a population above?
e: 1. Bihar Rule: Bihar Municipal Act ke tehat, lagbhag 2 lakh se zyada abadi wale sheharo ko Nagar Nigam ka darja milta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Convenor' of the Gram Sabha meetings in Bihar?
e: 1. Responsibility: Meeting bulana aur agenda set karna Mukhiya ka kaam hai. \n2. Record: Minutes likhne ka kaam Secretary karta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Constitution of Municipalities'?
e: 1. Logic: 243-Q hi teen tarah ki Municipalities (Nagar Panchayat, Parishad, Nigam) banata hai.

qe: The 'State Election Commission' is an independent body. True or False?
e: 1. Independence: Ise wahi status mila hai jo ECI ko mila hai, taaki local elections nishpaksh (fair) hon.

qe: In Bihar, 'Sarpanch' can sentence a person to jail. True or False?
o: False (गलत - केवल जुर्माना लगा सकता है)
e: 1. Power Limit: Sarpanch sirf financial fine (jurmana) laga sakta hai. Uske paas kisi ko jail (imprisonment) bhejne ki power nahi hai.

qe: Who is the 'First Citizen' of the city in a Municipal Corporation?
e: 1. Protocol: Shehar ke elected head (Mayor) ko hi pehla nagrik mana jata hai.

qe: Which Schedule contains the '18 items' for Municipalities?
e: 1. Fact: 11th (Panchayat-29), 12th (Municipality-18).

qe: Under Article 243-U, what is the duration of a Municipality?
e: 1. Rule: Pehli meeting se 5 saal. \n2. Dissolution: Bhang hone par 6 mahine mein election zaroori.

qe: Who is the 'Chief Executive' of a Nagar Parishad in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Elected head Chairman hai, par sarkari head Executive Officer (E.O.) hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Metropolitan Planning Committees'?
e: 1. Fact: Bade metropolitan cities ke liye ye special committees banti hain.

qe: Who decides the 'Salary and Allowances' of Panchayat members in Bihar?
e: 1. Power: Bihar sarkar ne Mukhiya, Sarpanch aur baaki sadasyo ke liye ek fixed 'Maandey' (honourarium) tay kiya hai.

qe: Is 'Gram Sabha' a permanent body?
e: 1. Nature: Gram Sabha kabhi bhang nahi hoti kyunki gaon ke log hamesha wahan rehte hain. \n2. Logic: Panchayat bhang ho sakti hai, Sabha nahi.

qe: Who is the 'Head' of the District Planning Committee?
o: Chairman of Zila Parishad (जिला परिषद का अध्यक्ष)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Zyadatar states mein Zila Parishad ka Adhyaksha hi iska head hota hai taaki democratic planning ho sake.

qe: Under Article 243-D, reservation of seats for Women is?
o: Not less than 1//3 (1//3 से कम नहीं)
e: 1. Central Law: Kam se kam 33%. \n2. Bihar: 50% reservation dene wala pehla state.

qe: Who was the 'Father of Local Self Government' in British India?
e: 1. History: 1882 mein Lord Ripon ne local bodies ke liye pehla bada kadam uthaya tha.

qe: The 'Municipal Commissioner' is usually a member of?
e: 1. Status: Ye ek senior IAS officer hota hai jise sarkar appoint karti hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Duration of Panchayats'?
e: 1. Logic: E for Expiration//End (5 saal ka term).

qe: Can the 'Sarpanch' be removed by a 'No-Confidence Motion' in Bihar?

e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Kisi bhi case ki sunvai ke liye Sarpanch + 4 Panches milkar bench banate hain. \n2. Decision: Faisla hamesha 'Majority' se hota hai.

qe: The 'State Finance Commission' (SFC) report is submitted to?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Flow: SFC (Governor) -> Governor (Assembly). \n2. Note: Governor hi report ko Vidhan Sabha ke samne rakhwata hai.

qe: Under Article 243-H, can a Panchayat raise a 'Loan'?

qe: Who was the 'First State Election Commissioner' of Bihar?

qe: Does the '73rd Amendment' provide for reservation of 'Chairman' posts for SC

qe: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to organize 'Village Panchayats'?

qe: The 'Panchayati Raj' was first adopted by which district?

qe: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act is related to:
qh: 73वां संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम किससे संबंधित है?
e: It gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj in 1992. / इसने 1992 में पंचायती राज को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया था।

qe: The 'Gram Sabha' is a permanent body at which level?

qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act gave 'Constitutional Status' to Panchayati Raj?
e: 1. Core Concept: 73rd Amendment (1992). \n2. Logic: Isne Samvidhan mein 'Part IX' aur '11th Schedule' joda. \n3. Fact: 24 April ko har saal 'Panchayati Raj Diwas' manaya jata hai.

qe: Bihar was the FIRST state to provide what percentage of reservation to Women in Panchayats?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Bihar ne 'Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006' ke tehat mahilaon ko 50% arakshan diya. \n2. Fact: Central law sirf 33% kehta hai, par Bihar ne use badha kar 50% kiya.

qe: The 'Three-tier' system of Panchayati Raj was recommended by which committee?
o: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (बलवंत राय मेहता समिति)
e: 1. History: 1957 mein Balwant Rai Mehta ne Gram, Block aur Zila level par 3-tier system ki rai di thi. \n2. Fact: Inhe 'Father of Panchayati Raj' in India bhi kaha jata hai.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to 'Organize Village Panchayats'?
e: 1. Core Concept: DPSP. \n2. Logic: Article 40 Gandhi ji ke sapno ko pura karne ke liye rakha gaya tha. \n3. Note: Tab ye sirf ek nirdesh tha, mandatory nahi.

qe: What is the minimum 'Age' to contest elections for a Mukhiya or Ward Member in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility. \n2. Logic: Vote dene ke liye 18 saal, par election ladne ke liye 21 saal hona zaroori hai. \n3. Comparison: MLA ke liye 25 saal chahiye.

qe: The 'Gram Katchery' (ग्राम कचहरी) in Bihar is headed by?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Mukhiya administrative kaam dekhta hai, par Sarpanch 'Gram Katchery' ka head hota hai jo chhote-mote jhagde suljhata hai. \n2. Power: Sarpanch ₹10,000 tak ke maamlo ki sunvai kar sakta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Executive Officer' at the Panchayat Samiti (Block) level?
e: 1. Structure: Block level par BDO hi executive head hota hai jo Panchayat Samiti ke kamo ko lagoo karta hai. \n2. Elected Head: Panchayat Samiti ka elected head 'Pramukh' hota hai.

qe: Which Schedule was added to the Constitution for 'Urban Local Bodies' (Municipalities)?
e: 1. Core Concept: 74th Amendment. \n2. Logic: 11th Schedule Panchayato ke liye hai aur 12th Municipalities ke liye. \n3. List: 12th Schedule mein 18 subjects (kaam) diye gaye hain.

qe: The 'State Election Commission' conducts elections for?
e: 1. Logic: ECI (India) bade elections karwata hai, par SEC sirf local bodies ke liye banta hai. \n2. Article: Article 243K iska zikr karta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Administrative Head' of a Gram Panchayat in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Mukhiya chuna hua hota hai (Elected), par Panchayat Secretary sarkari naukar hota hai jo records rakhta hai. \n2. Note: Ise 'Panchayat Sewak' bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is the tenure of Panchayati Raj institutions in Bihar?
e: 1. Rule: Pehli meeting se exact 5 saal tak. \n2. Dissolution: Agar pehle bhang ho jaye, toh 6 mahine ke andar election hona mandatory hai.

qe: The 'Zila Parishad' Chairman in Bihar is called?
e: 1. Hierarchy: Gram Panchayat (Mukhiya) -> Panchayat Samiti (Pramukh) -> Zila Parishad (Adhyaksha).

qe: Which Article provides for the 'State Finance Commission' for Panchayats?
e: 1. Logic: 280 Central Finance Commission ke liye hai, 243-I State ke liye. \n2. Work: Ye tay karta hai ki state govt ka kitna paisa Panchayato ko milega.

qe: The 'Gram Sabha' consists of:
o: All registered voters of the village (गाँव के सभी पंजीकृत मतदाता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Direct Democracy. \n2. Fact: Har wo insaan jiska naam voter list mein hai, wo Gram Sabha ka member hota hai. \n3. Power: Ye Panchayat ke kamo ka audit karti hai.

qe: How many functional items are listed in the '11th Schedule' of the Constitution?
e: 1. Logic: Panchayato ko 29 subjects par kaam karne ki power di gayi hai (jaise Agriculture, Health, Road). \n2. Municipalities: Unke liye 12th Schedule mein 18 items hain.

qe: Who appoints the 'State Election Commissioner' of Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Local bodies ke saare head Governor hi appoint karta hai. \n2. Note: Use hatane ka process High Court ke judge jaisa tough hota hai.

qe: In Bihar, what is the 'Population Criteria' for forming a Gram Panchayat?
e: 1. Bihar Rule: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act ke hisab se lagbhag 7,000 ki abadi par ek Gram Panchayat banti hai. \n2. Ward: Lagbhag 500 ki abadi par ek 'Ward' banta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief' of the Gram Katchery in Bihar?
e: 1. Role: Sarpanch kanooni mamlo ko dekhta hai. \n2. Support: Sarpanch ki help ke liye ek 'Nyay Mitra' (Law expert) hota hai.

qe: Which part of the Constitution deals with 'The Municipalities'?
e: 1. Structure: Part IX (Panchayat), Part IX-A (Municipalities). \n2. Addition: Ise 74th Amendment (1992) se joda gaya.

qe: The 'District Planning Committee' (DPC) is mentioned in which Article?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: DPC ka kaam Zila Parishad aur Municipalities ke plans ko milakar ek 'Draft Development Plan' banana hota hai.

qe: Who elects the 'Up-Mukhiya' (Deputy Mukhiya) in a Gram Panchayat in Bihar?
o: Elected Ward Members among themselves (निर्वाचित वार्ड सदस्यों द्वारा अपने बीच से)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Mukhiya ka election 'Direct' hota hai (janata gunti hai). \n2. Process: Par Up-Mukhiya ka election 'Indirect' hota hai, jahan Ward Members apne beech se ek ko chunte hain. \n3. Tie: Agar vote barabar ho jayein, toh faisla 'Lottery' se hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Reservation of Seats' for SC, ST and Women in Panchayats?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Justice. \n2. Logic: 243-D (D for Dalits//Disadvantaged) reservation se deal karta hai. \n3. Fact: Bihar mein isi Article ke tehat BC (Backwards) ko bhi reservation diya gaya hai.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Term' for which a Panchayat can be dissolved?
e: 1. Rule: Article 243-E. Agar Panchayat bhang hoti hai, toh 6 mahine ke andar election karwana mandatory hai. \n2. Note: Agar term khatam hone mein sirf 6 mahine bache hon, toh naya election zaroori nahi hota.

qe: Who is the 'Political Head' of a Municipal Corporation (Nagar Nigam) in Bihar?
e: 1. Structure: Nagar Nigam ka elected head Mayor hota hai. \n2. Update: Bihar mein ab Mayor aur Deputy Mayor ka election janata 'Direct' (seedhe) karti hai. \n3. Fact: Commissioner sarkari (IAS) officer hota hai.

qe: Under Article 243-S, 'Wards Committees' are mandatory for municipalities having population of?
o: 3 Lakh or more (3 लाख या अधिक)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Badi cities mein behtar management ke liye Ward Committees banai jati hain. \n2. Logic: Ye janata ki samasyaon ko Ward level par hi suljhane ke liye hoti hain.

qe: Who provides the 'Nyay Mitra' (Law Assistant) to help the Sarpanch in Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Nyay Mitra ek kanooni expert (vakeel) hota hai jise sarkar appoint karti hai taaki Sarpanch kanoon ke hisab se faisle le sake. \n2. Fact: Iska kaam sirf 'Salah' dena hota hai.

qe: The '12th Schedule' of the Constitution lists how many functional items for Municipalities?
e: 1. Comparison: 11th Schedule (Panchayat) - 29 items. 12th Schedule (Municipalities) - 18 items. \n2. Subjects: Isme Fire services, Urban forestry, Slum improvement jaise kaam shamil hain.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Constitution of Finance Commission' to review financial position of Panchayats?
o: Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 243-I Panchayato ke liye hai aur 243-Y Municipalities ke liye. \n2. Period: Governor ise har 5 saal mein banata hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Remove' the Mukhiya in Bihar if he is found guilty of misconduct?
e: 1. Power: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act ke tehat, sarkar (Department of Panchayati Raj) jaanch ke baad Mukhiya ko pad se hata sakti hai. \n2. Appeal: Mukhiya iske khilaaf court ja sakta hai.

qe: The 'Panchayat Samiti' in Bihar is the ________ level of the Panchayati Raj system.
e: 1. Structure: Gram Panchayat (Ground) -> Panchayat Samiti (Middle) -> Zila Parishad (Top). \n2. Logic: Ye gaon aur zile ke beech ka bridge hai.

qe: Under Article 243-Q, a 'Nagar Panchayat' is formed for?
o: Transition areas from rural to urban (ग्रामीण से शहरी संक्रमणकालीन क्षेत्र)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 3 types of Municipalities: 1. Nagar Panchayat (Transition gaon se shehar). 2. Nagar Parishad (Chote shehar). 3. Nagar Nigam (Bade shehar).

qe: What is the 'Audit' authority of the Gram Sabha in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Audit. \n2. Logic: Gram Sabha ye check karti hai ki jo paisa gaon ke liye aaya, wo sach mein kharch hua ya nahi. \n3. Importance: Isse bhrashtachar par rok lagti hai.

qe: Who provides the 'Voter List' for Panchayat elections in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: SEC ki apni voter list hoti hai jo ECI ki list se alag ho sakti hai. \n2. Responsibility: Article 243-K ke tehat ye SEC ka kaam hai.

qe: Can a person be a member of both 'Zila Parishad' and 'Legislative Assembly' (MLA) at once?
e: 1. Rule: Dual membership par rok hai. Agar koi MLA ban jata hai, toh use apni local body ki seat chhodni padegi. \n2. Logic: Ek insaan do jagah ka budget aur power control nahi kar sakta.

qe: The '73rd Amendment' does NOT apply to which of the following states?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 243-M ke tehat in states ko chhoot mili hai kyunki wahan unki apni tribal systems hain. \n2. Special Fact: West Bengal ka 'Darjeeling District' bhi isse bahar hai.

qe: Who is the 'Executive Officer' of a Municipal Corporation in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Mayor 'Head' hai, par asli administrative kaam Municipal Commissioner (IAS rank) karta hai. \n2. Analogy: Jaise CM aur Chief Secretary.

qe: Under Article 243-W, who has the power to 'Empower' Municipalities with duties?
e: 1. Federal Logic: Local bodies 'State List' ka subject hain, isliye Assembly hi tay karti hai ki unhe kitni power deni hai.

o: No immediate election required (तत्काल चुनाव की आवश्यकता नहीं)
e: 1. Rule: Agar 6 mahine se kam time bacha hai, toh alag se by-election karwane ki zaroorat nahi hai. \n2. Note: Seedha naya general election hi hoga.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'District Planning Committee' (DPC)?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: DPC shehari aur gramin dono plans ko milakar poore zile ka plan banati hai. \n2. Structure: Isme 4//5 members elected hote hain.

e: 1. Power: Bihar mein Sarpanch dono tarah ke chhote cases sun sakta hai. \n2. Limit: Par wo kisi ko jail nahi bhej sakta, sirf fine (jurmana) laga sakta hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Boundaries' of a Ward in a Bihar Municipal Corporation?
e: 1. Fact: Ward ka delimitation (parisiman) Bihar sarkar ka Urban Development department karta hai.

qe: Under Article 243-G, what is the 'Panchayat's Responsibility'?
o: Economic development and social justice (आर्थिक विकास और सामाजिक न्याय)
e: 1. Mission: Panchayato ko sirf galiyan banane ke liye nahi, balki gaon ke vikas ke liye banaya gaya hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief' of the Panchayat Samiti in Bihar?
e: 1. Status: Pramukh ko Block level ke saare Mukhiya aur Samiti members chunte hain.

qe: Can the 'State Election Commissioner' be removed by the Governor easily?
o: No, only on grounds and manner of a High Court Judge (नहीं, केवल HC जज के समान तरीके से)
e: 1. Security: SEC ko independence di gayi hai taaki wo bina dare election karwa sake. \n2. Method: Removal ke liye President aur Parliament ka involvement zaroori hota hai.

qe: The 'Nagar Nigam' (Municipal Corporation) is established for population above?
o: As decided by the State (राज्य द्वारा निर्धारित)

qe: Who is the 'Secretary' of the Zila Parishad in Bihar?
o: DDC (Deputy Development Commissioner - उप विकास आयुक्त)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Zila Parishad ka executive kaam DDC dekhta hai jo IAS rank ka hota hai.

qe: Under Article 243-B, 'Panchayats' are mandatory for states having population above?
e: 1. Rule: Jis state ki abadi 20 lakh se kam hai, wahan 3-tier system hona zaroori nahi hai (Middle level skip ho sakta hai).

qe: Which body is responsible for 'Audit' of Municipal accounts?
o: State Government as per Law (कानून के अनुसार राज्य सरकार)
e: 1. Fact: State Legislature tay karta hai ki audit kaise aur kaun karega.

qe: Who is the 'First Citizen' of a City in Bihar?
e: 1. Protocol: Shehar ka pehla sammanit nagrik Mayor hota hai.

qe: The 'Gram Sabha' must meet at least how many times in a year in Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar Rule: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act ke tehat saal mein kam se kam 4 meetings (har 3 mahine mein ek) honi zaroori hain.

qe: Under the Bihar Panchayat Raj Act 2006, what is the percentage of seats reserved for EBCs (BC-I)?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Bihar ne pichde vargo (EBC) ko 20% arakshan diya hai. \n2. Limit: Ye arakshan Mukhiya, Pramukh aur Adhyaksha sabhi pado par lagu hota hai. \n3. Fact: Isse samaj ke dabbe hue vargo ko netritva (leadership) milta hai.

qe: Who elects the 'Up-Sarpanch' in the Gram Katchery of Bihar?
o: Elected Panches among themselves (निर्वाचित पंचों द्वारा अपने बीच से)
e: 1. Process: Sarpanch ka chunav direct hota hai, par Up-Sarpanch ko elected Panches milkar chunte hain. \n2. Role: Sarpanch ki অনুপস্থিতi (absence) mein ye Katchery ki adhyakshta karta hai.

qe: The 'Panchayat Samiti' (Block Level) is accountable for its functions to?
e: 1. Hierarchy: 3-tier system mein niche wali body upar wali ko report karti hai. \n2. Path: Gram Panchayat -> Panchayat Samiti -> Zila Parishad.

qe: Article 243-F deals with the 'Disqualifications' for membership. Who is the final authority?
o: Authority prescribed by State Law (राज्य कानून द्वारा निर्धारित अधिकारी)
e: 1. Core Concept: Authority. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar mein election ke baad disqualification par DM ya prescribed authority faisla leti hai. \n3. Age: 21 saal se kam age hona sabse bada ground hai.

qe: What is the 'Population' limit for a 'Nagar Parishad' (Municipal Council) in Bihar?
e: 1. Structure: Nagar Panchayat (12k-40k), Nagar Parishad (40k-2 Lakh), Nagar Nigam (Above 2 Lakh). \n2. Logic: Ye shehar ki abadi par depend karta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief Executive Officer' of the Zila Parishad in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Elected head Adhyaksha hota hai, par administrative head DDC (Deputy Development Commissioner) hota hai jo IAS rank ka hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Powers, Authority and Responsibilities' of Municipalities?
e: 1. Logic: 243-G Panchayato ke liye hai aur 243-W Municipalities ke liye. \n2. Scope: Isme 12th Schedule ke 18 subjects shamil hain.

qe: The 'Nyay Mitra' in Bihar must be a graduate in?
e: 1. Requirement: Chunki Nyay Mitra ko Sarpanch ko kanooni salah deni hoti hai, isliye uska 'Law Graduate' hona zaroori hai. \n2. Fact: Ye ek contractual sarkari pad hai.

qe: Under Article 243-E, if a Panchayat is dissolved, election MUST be held within?
e: 1. Rule: Samvidhan kehta hai ki seat 6 mahine se zyada khali nahi reh sakti. \n2. Note: Nayi Panchayat bache hue samay (remainder term) ke liye hi kaam karegi.

qe: Who has the power to 'Divide' a Gram Panchayat into Wards in Bihar?
e: 1. Power: DM (Collector) hi wards ki boundary aur ginti tay karta hai. \n2. Logic: Lagbhag 500 ki abadi par ek ward banaya jata hai.

qe: The '74th Constitutional Amendment' came into force on?
e: 1. Date: 73rd Amendment 24 April ko aur 74th Amendment 1 June ko lagu hua tha. \n2. Goal: Urban local governance ko mazboot karna.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian' of the Gram Panchayat's properties and funds?
e: 1. Role: Mukhiya hi executive head hai aur sari execution ki zimmedari uski hoti hai. \n2. Fact: Paisa nikalne ke liye Mukhiya aur Panchayat Secretary dono ke sign chahiye hote hain.

qe: Under Article 243-T, 'Women Reservation' in Municipalities is?
o: Not less than 1//3 (1//3 से कम नहीं)
e: 1. Central Law: 74th Amendment kam se kam 33% kehta hai. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar ne ise badha kar 50% kar diya hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Executive Officer' (E.O.) of a Nagar Parishad in Bihar?
o: Executive Officer appointed by Govt (सरकार द्वारा नियुक्त कार्यपालक पदाधिकारी)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Nagar Nigam mein 'Commissioner' hota hai, Nagar Parishad//Panchayat mein 'Executive Officer' hota hai.

qe: The 'PESA Act' (1996) extends Panchayati Raj to?
e: 1. Full Form: Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act. \n2. Logic: Ye tribal logo ki paramparao ko bachate hue unhe self-rule deta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief' of the Zila Parishad elected by members in Bihar?
e: 1. Structure: Zila Parishad ke elected members apne beech se ek Adhyaksha aur ek Up-Adhyaksha chunte hain.

qe: Article 243-C deals with the 'Composition' of Panchayats. Who decides the number of seats?
o: The State Legislature by Law (राज्य विधानमंडल कानून द्वारा)
e: 1. Power: Har state ki Assembly khud tay karti hai ki unke yahan kitne ward ya kitni seats hongi.

qe: The 'Gram Katchery' in Bihar has a 'Secretary' (Sarkari). Who is he?
e: 1. Distinction: Gram Panchayat ke liye 'Panchayat Secretary' hota hai, aur Gram Katchery ke liye 'Nyay Secretary' (Justice Secretary) hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Audit of Accounts' of Municipalities?
e: 1. Logic: 243-J (Panchayat audit), 243-Z (Municipality audit). \n2. Importance: Isse bhrashtachar par lagaam lagti hai.

qe: In Bihar, 'Ward Parshad' (Ward Councillor) is elected for?
e: 1. Terminology: Gaon mein 'Ward Member' hota hai, shehar mein 'Ward Parshad' (Councillor) hota hai.

qe: Under Article 243-R, members of Municipalities are elected by?
o: Direct Election by the people (जनता द्वारा प्रत्यक्ष चुनाव)
e: 1. Rule: Municipal areas ko wards mein baanta jata hai aur har ward ki janata apna Councillor pratyaksh (direct) chunti hai.

qe: Who is the 'Presiding Officer' of the meeting of Panchayat Samiti in Bihar?
e: 1. Hierarchy: Block level par elected head 'Pramukh' hi meeting chair karta hai. \n2. Absence: Pramukh nahi ho toh Up-Pramukh meeting leta hai.

qe: The 'District Planning Committee' (DPC) must have what fraction of elected members?

qe: Who conducts 'Social Audit' of Urban bodies?
e: 1. Goal: Shehar ke vikas mein jan-bhagidari.

qe: The State Election Commissioner can be removed from office ONLY in the same manner as?
o: A Judge of the High Court (उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 243-K(2). SEC ko hatane ka tarika wahi hai jo HC Judge ka hota hai (Parliamentary removal). \n2. Reason: Taaki wo bina kisi rajnitik dawab (CM ya Governor) ke nishpaksh chunav kara sake.

qe: Under Article 243-ZD, what fraction of members of the District Planning Committee (DPC) are elected from within?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Zile ki planning mein elected leaders ka dawab rahe, isliye 4//5 sadasya Zila Parishad aur Municipalities ke elected members apne beech se chunte hain. \n2. Note: Baki 1//5 nominated hote hain.

qe: The Bihar Panchayat Raj Act 2006 provides for 'Gram Katchery'. Can it hear cases related to 'Marriage and Divorce'?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Sarpanch sirf chhote civil (money recovery//land boundary) aur criminal (petty theft//abuse) cases sun sakta hai. \n2. Restriction: Family matters, Murder, ya bade crimes iske daayre se bahar hain.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Constitution of Finance Commission' specifically for Municipalities?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: 243-I Panchayato ke liye hai, par 243-Y Municipalities ke liye. \n2. Fact: Bihar mein Governor ek hi Finance Commission banata hai jo dono bodies ke liye fund distribution tay karta hai.

qe: If a question arises about 'Disqualification' under Article 243-F, who is the authority decided by State Law?
o: The Prescribed Authority (e.g., DM or SEC in Bihar)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Samvidhan ne kisi ek officer ka naam nahi liya. Usne State Legislature ko power di ki wo 'Authority' chune. \n2. Bihar Link: Bihar mein chunav ke baad ke vivado (post-election disputes) par SEC ya DM action leta hai.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Term' for which a person can act as an 'Interim' Mukhiya in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Agar Mukhiya ka pad khali ho jaye, toh Up-Mukhiya charge leta hai, par 6 mahine ke andar by-election hona mandatory hai (Art 243-E).

qe: Under the 'PESA Act 1996', who has the power to manage 'Minor Water Bodies' in Scheduled Areas?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: PESA Act tribal logo ko jal, jangal aur zameen par haq deta hai. \n2. Logic: Tribal areas mein Gram Sabha ko state government se zyada power di gayi hai resource management ke liye.

qe: Can a person contest for 'Mukhiya' and 'Zila Parishad Member' simultaneously in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Election 'lad' sakta hai, par agar dono jeet jaye, toh use ek seat chhodni padegi (Multiple Membership rule).

qe: Who decides the 'Boundaries' of Municipal Wards during Delimitation in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Voter list SEC banata hai, par Ward ki boundary (delimitation) Bihar sarkar ka Urban Development Department tay karta hai.

qe: Which Article allows the 'Legislature of a State' to decide on voting rights of MPs
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye ek 'Voluntary' (swaichhik) provision hai. Bihar ne MLAs//MPs ko local bodies ki meetings mein bhag lene ka haq diya hai.

qe: In Bihar, 'Nyay Mitra' provides legal help. Can they be removed by the Sarpanch?
o: No, only by State Govt//DM (नहीं, केवल राज्य सरकार//DM द्वारा)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Nyay Mitra ek sarkari contractual appointee hai. Sarpanch sirf report de sakta hai, par hata sirf sarkar hi sakti hai.

qe: Under Article 243-J, the audit report of Panchayats is laid before?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Chunki audit rules Assembly banati hai, isliye reports bhi Assembly ke samne hi rakhi jati hain taaki poore rajya ko pata chale paisa kahan kharch hua.

qe: Does the '74th Amendment' apply to the 'Hill Areas of Manipur'?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 243-ZC ke tehat Manipur ke hill areas (jahan District Councils hain) ko isse chhoot mili hai. \n2. Reason: Unki apni alag administrative vyavastha hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Arbitrator' in case of a boundary dispute between two Municipalities in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Administrative disputes ko Bihar sarkar ka Urban Development department hi suljhata hai.

qe: Article 243-G says Panchayats shall have powers for 'Economic Development'. Does it include 'Social Forestry'?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 11th Schedule ke 29 items mein 'Social Forestry' aur 'Minor Forest Produce' shamil hain. Ye gaon ki arthvyavastha ke liye zaroori hai.

qe: In Bihar, what is the 'Maximum Number' of members allowed in a Gram Katchery bench?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Kisi bhi case ki sunvai ke liye Sarpanch + 4 Panches milkar bench banate hain. \n2. Decision: Faisla hamesha 'Majority' se hota hai.

qe: The 'State Finance Commission' (SFC) report is submitted to?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Flow: SFC (Governor) -> Governor (Assembly). \n2. Note: Governor hi report ko Vidhan Sabha ke samne rakhwata hai.

qe: Under Article 243-H, can a Panchayat raise a 'Loan'?
o: Yes, if authorized by State Legislature (हाँ, यदि विधानमंडल अनुमति दे)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Panchayato ko financial freedom dene ke liye Assembly kanoon banakar unhe karz lene ki power de sakti hai.

qe: Who was the 'First State Election Commissioner' of Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar History: 1994 mein SEC banne ke baad N.B. Lohani pehle commissioner bane the. \n2. Fact: Bihar mein pehla Panchayat chunav 73rd amendment ke baad 2001 mein hua tha.

qe: Does the '73rd Amendment' provide for reservation of 'Chairman' posts for SC
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 243-D(4). Sirf seats hi nahi, balki Mukhiya, Pramukh aur Adhyaksha ke pad bhi SC//ST ke liye population ke hisab se reserved hote hain.

qe: Is 'Panchayati Raj' a Constitutional Body?
e: 1. Fact: 73rd Amendment ke baad ye Samvidhan ka hissa hai (Part IX).

qe: Is 'Panchayati Raj' mentioned in the 7th Schedule?
e: 1. Fact: Ye state ka vishay hai, isliye Assembly kanoon banati hai.

qe: The 'Panchayati Raj' is mentioned in which List of the 7th Schedule?
e: 1. Logic: Local bodies state ka subject hain, isliye inpar kanoon State Assembly banati hai.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to organize 'Village Panchayats'?

e: 1. Core Concept: Gandhian Principles ka hissa. \\n2. Logic: Gandhi ji ka sapna tha 'Gram Swaraj'. Article 40 isi sapne ko pura karne ka nirdesh deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi Article ki wajah se baad mein 73rd Amendment (1992) laya gaya.

qe: The 'Panchayati Raj' was first adopted by which district?

qe: The 'Gram Sabha' is a permanent body at which level?
qh: 'ग्राम सभा' किस स्तर पर एक स्थायी निकाय है?
e: Gram Sabha consists of all registered voters of a village. / ग्राम सभा में गाँव के सभी पंजीकृत मतदाता शामिल होते हैं।
